title: The Spire of Highmoor Again
author: Paloma Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Okafor, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
